purpose: Draft D3 interface-census ledger (#290): the frozen conjugate-boundary join passes interface dependence and closure preservation. D8c2 was not run and no diversity advantage is claimed.

entries.claim: With interface_ok(a,b) := last(a) = CONJUGATE[first(b)] and join(a,b) := interface_ok(a,b) and is_zfa(a++b), nonempty bases of length 3 have K_k values 1, 2, 4, and 6 at extension bound 3. The census has 584 bases, 1,544 admitted joins, and 0 closure failures. The relation is therefore interface-dependent and closure-preserving.
entries.formal_scope: Finite twist words of length 1-3 over the 8-twist alphabet; conjugate-boundary join; extension bound 3; canonical word equivalence. K_k is a provisional count, not a probability or independent measure. No homogeneous/heterogeneous comparison (D8c2), no three-axis advantage, no Penrose/persistence/physical claim.
entries.comparator: Exhaustive finite census in diversity_interface.py and data/diversity_d3_census.json.
entries.kill_condition: Any admitted join not ZFA-closed, or K_k constant across bases at fixed length and extension bound (refuting interface dependence).
